```{# ========================================================}
# Compute differential entropy of an alpha-Stable distribution
# ========================================================

Entropy_stable <- function(alpha, beta=0, gamma=1, delta=0, M=50, rel.tol=1e-6, abs.tol=1e-8, subdivisions=2000) {
  
  integrand <- function(x) {
    
    fx <- dstable(x, alpha=alpha, beta=beta, gamma=gamma, delta=delta, pm=1)
    
    # vetorizar tratamento de zeros/negativos (por numérica)
    out <- -fx * log(fx)
    
    out[!is.finite(out) | fx <= 0] <- 0
    out
    
  }
  
  res <- integrate(integrand, lower=-M, upper=M,
                   rel.tol=rel.tol, abs.tol=abs.tol,
                   subdivisions=subdivisions, stop.on.error=FALSE)
  
  if (!identical(res$message, "OK")) warning(res$message)
  res$value
}

H_cauchy <- Entropy_stable(alpha=1, beta=0, gamma=1, delta=0, M=80)
H_stable15 <- Entropy_stable(alpha=1.5, beta=0, gamma=1, delta=0, M=60)
H_normal <- Entropy_stable(alpha=2, beta=0, gamma=1, delta=0, M=10)

cat("Entropia Cauchy(0,1):", H_cauchy, "\n")
cat("Entropia α-estável (α=1.5, β=0, γ=1):", H_stable15, "\n")
cat("Entropia Normal(0,1):", H_normal, "\n")

# ========================================================
# Get estimates of entropies from an alpha-stable population,  
# using the Pareto and t-Student kernel functions
# ------------------------------------------------------------

Get.Estimates <- function(alpha.s, n.size, r.size, nu.0 = alpha.s, h.0 = 1/sqrt(n.size))
{
  
  # Pareto kernel
  H.hat.P     <- NULL
  alpha.hat.P <- NULL
  beta.hat.P  <- NULL
  # t Student kernel
  H.hat.T     <- NULL
  alpha.hat.T <- NULL
  beta.hat.T  <- NULL

  for (index in 1:r.size) {
    
    message("alpha = ", alpha.s, " ...processing ", index, " date/time = ", Sys.time())
    
    Sys.sleep(0.01)
    flush.console()
    x <- rstable(n.size, alpha = alpha.s, beta = 0, gamma = 1, delta = 0, pm = 1)
    # Using Pareto kernel
    H.result <- optim(Entropy.P, par = c(nu.0,h.0), x.var = x)
    H.hat.P[index]     <- H.result$value
    alpha.hat.P[index] <- H.result$par[1]
    beta.hat.P[index]  <- H.result$par[2]
    # Using t Student kernel
    H.result <- optim(Entropy.T, par = c(nu.0,h.0), x.var = x)
    H.hat.T[index]     <- H.result$value
    alpha.hat.T[index] <- H.result$par[1]
    beta.hat.T[index]  <- H.result$par[2]

  }
  
  return(data.frame(alpha.s,n.size,r.size,H.hat.P,H.hat.T,alpha.hat.P,alpha.hat.T,beta.hat.P,beta.hat.T))
  
}

```

```{r}

MCExperiment <- function(alpha.s,n.size,r.size) {
  
  simul <- Get.Estimates(as.numeric(alpha.s)/10, as.numeric(n.size), as.numeric(r.size))
  
  simul$alpha.hat.P  <- pmin(simul$alpha.hat.P, 2)
  
  simul$alpha.hat.T  <- pmin(simul$alpha.hat.T, 2)
  
  write.xlsx(simul, paste0("PStable", alpha.s, "_", n.size, "_", r.size, ".xlsx"))

  }
```

# Figure A Pareto

n = 60

```{r}

# Resumo por alpha.s
sum_out <- output %>%
  group_by(alpha.s) %>%
  summarise(
    mean_hat = mean(alpha.hat.P, na.rm = TRUE),            # "ponto médio" (média)
    q025     = quantile(alpha.hat.P, 0.025, na.rm = TRUE), # 2,5%
    q975     = quantile(alpha.hat.P, 0.975, na.rm = TRUE)  # 97,5%
  ) %>%
  arrange(alpha.s)

gg <- ggplot(output, aes(x = alpha.s, y = alpha.hat.P)) +
  # banda de incerteza (2,5%–97,5%)
  geom_ribbon(
    data = sum_out,
    aes(ymin = q025, ymax = q975, x = alpha.s),
    inherit.aes = FALSE, fill = "grey70", alpha = 0.35
  ) +
  # pontos
  geom_point(size = 1) +
  # linha das médias por alpha.s
  geom_line(
    data = sum_out,
    aes(y = mean_hat, x = alpha.s),
    linewidth = 1.2, color = "blue"
  ) +
  # reta esperada: hat(alpha) = alpha.s
  #geom_abline(intercept = 0, slope = 1, linetype = "dashed", color = "red", linewidth = 1.2) +
  ggtitle(expression(italic(n) == 60)) +
  ylab(expression(hat(alpha))) +
  xlab(expression(alpha[S])) +
  theme(
    text = element_text(family = "Times New Roman", size = 20, colour = "black"),
    axis.title.y = element_text(angle = 90, colour = "black"),
    axis.title.x = element_text(vjust = -0.5),
    plot.title = element_text(size = 20, hjust = 0.5)
  )

png("FigureAlpha0060P.png",width = 14,height = 12,units = 'cm',res = 300)

gg + scale_x_continuous(limits = c(0.5, 2.1), breaks = seq(0.6,2,by = 0.2))

dev.off()

```
